note: Read-only decoding of the vendor files in place. Units come from the channel names and the extracted manual; sentinels are recorded only where proven.

header.note: 0x04 seed bytes are the recorder's LCG values; 0x08 is a constant 0x3D4CCCCD (0.05) in this writer build and is not the effective cadence (see record_stream). Whether 0x00-0x07 are rewritten at close is OPEN (crash-truncated sample).

record_stream.cadence_evidence: MainGameTickUpdate 0x0042C690 lines 88-94: player record every dword_8AD23C frames of the 400-frame counter; environment record at counter 0 (1 Hz); observed 0.1 s cadence = divisor 40

field_map.source: f32 @ S+0x004 (24 B block copied from S+4)
atan2 of two rotation-matrix dot products on S+0x01C (elements +0x1C..+0x74)

spt.note: Header, descriptors, session hashes, the XOR-encoded .VEH copy and the typed record stream are decoded. RPM channels already carry the game's own rad/s -> RPM factor 9.549296585513721; yaw is radians in .spt. A torn or crash-cut file decodes up to the last complete record; the partial tail is reported, never guessed.
